title: Sleep and Behavior in Children With Cleft Palate
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether cleft palate repair increases the risk for obstructive sleep apnea in children and whether sleep apnea could explain learning and behavior difficulties that are often observed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Previous cleft palate repair
* Age 6-15 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other condition that impacts the interpretation of PSG or neurobehavioral assessments
* Being treated for sleep apnea with CPAP
study_population: Children will be recruited from cleft palate clinics
